account_activation_tokens_single_end.name: account_activation_tokens_single_end
account_activation_tokens_single_end.value: not ("account_activation_tokens"."consumed_at" is not null and "account_activation_tokens"."revoked_at" is not null)

training_assignments_meaningful.name: training_assignments_meaningful
training_assignments_meaningful.value: "training_exercise_assignments"."sets" is not null or "training_exercise_assignments"."reps" is not null or "training_exercise_assignments"."total_reps" is not null or "training_exercise_assignments"."duration_seconds" is not null or "training_exercise_assignments"."prescription_text" is not null

training_programs_period.name: training_programs_period
training_programs_period.value: "training_programs"."ends_on" is null or "training_programs"."starts_on" is null or "training_programs"."ends_on" >= "training_programs"."starts_on"

workout_exercise_sets_actuals_nonnegativ.name: workout_exercise_sets_actuals_nonnegative
workout_exercise_sets_actuals_nonnegativ.value:
("workout_exercise_sets"."actual_reps" is null or "workout_exercise_sets"."actual_reps" >= 0)
        and ("workout_exercise_sets"."actual_weight" is null or "workout_exercise_sets"."actual_weight" >= 0)

workout_session_exercises_actuals_nonneg.name: workout_session_exercises_actuals_nonnegative
workout_session_exercises_actuals_nonneg.value:
("workout_session_exercises"."actual_reps" is null or "workout_session_exercises"."actual_reps" >= 0)
        and ("workout_session_exercises"."actual_duration_seconds" is null or "workout_session_exercises"."actual_duration_seconds" >= 0)
        and ("workout_session_exercises"."actual_weight" is null or "workout_session_exercises"."actual_weight" >= 0)

workout_sessions_status_timestamps.name: workout_sessions_status_timestamps
workout_sessions_status_timestamps.value:
("workout_sessions"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' and "workout_sessions"."completed_at" is null and "workout_sessions"."abandoned_at" is null)
        or ("workout_sessions"."status" = 'COMPLETED' and "workout_sessions"."completed_at" is not null and "workout_sessions"."abandoned_at" is null)
        or ("workout_sessions"."status" = 'ABANDONED' and "workout_sessions"."abandoned_at" is not null and "workout_sessions"."completed_at" is null)

nutrition_documents_status_timestamps.name: nutrition_documents_status_timestamps
nutrition_documents_status_timestamps.value:
("nutrition_documents"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "nutrition_documents"."activated_at" is null and "nutrition_documents"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("nutrition_documents"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "nutrition_documents"."activated_at" is not null and "nutrition_documents"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("nutrition_documents"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' and "nutrition_documents"."archived_at" is not null)
